purpose: Defines the logical data model of doc-link: information items, identifiers, sources, relations, multiplicity, value meaning and freshness, independent of the physical schema.
summary: Model boundary: identity, relations, versions and primary sources without a physical schema
Table of logical information items with identification, attributes, sources and relations
Document information is stored once per document ID and shared across all keys
Confirmed ToC holds membership, references, reflected hashes, section entries and last check state
Multiplicity rules between keys, document IDs and reference descriptions
Sections are identified by DLID at heading ends; headings are not permanent IDs
Document ID differs from content hash; reference definition lines are excluded from the hash
Reference check results hold only for the recorded directory and time
Documents leaving the index target are removed from the confirmed ToC of that key
tasks: Designing or changing the data model
Implementing document information and ToC storage
Implementing reference description and check results
Implementing section entries and section IDs
title: DES-003 論理データモデル
